title: Sync triggers
summary: Change tracking for sync lives in SQLite triggers kept in step with the schema.

requirements.text: Every synced table has insert, update and delete triggers that record its changes for sync.
A migration that adds a column re-creates that table's triggers, and one that rebuilds a table re-creates them.
Trigger SQL runs on SQLite 3.39, the version on Android 14.
A test fails when a synced table lacks its triggers or a trigger misses a column.
